name: Swarm map
why: How many agents acted on a few shared places, as the orientation mapped it: a row per agent with its goal, a card per significant action in event order under its UTC time, and the links between actions that reply to, support, contradict or relate to each other; filtered by agent, signature, thread, link type or text, a card's neighbourhood lit on hover, and each action's record beside the chart with the text its save added.
data: A release team's ops wiki for one night, in which build, QA, release and docs agents coordinate a release candidate through four shared pages, and the map of it the orientation's swarm step writes. revisions.jsonl: one line per save, each the whole page as saved (`text`), with `rev_id`, `page`, `seq`, the account that saved it and `time` in UTC; saves before 4 March name the account `editor` and later ones `user`, two saves carry no time, and the export's last line was cut off (the page reports it). pages.jsonl: the page index, one line per page with its revision count, first and last write and editors. swarm.json: the map, whose actions cite the saves by line, give the save before each as `before` and quote the text it added; two accounts sign as one crew (`signs_as`), and the actions without a time head a column "Time unknown".

accepts.means: the record on line <n>: its action's card when the map holds it, else the record beside the map with the agent and thread it names

declares.means: one agent's row: its actions and the records that show its goal
one thread's actions, such as thread:T2, filtered to it
one link, such as 12-11: the two actions it joins and its evidence
